direction: Side-scrolling fantasy brawler inspired by classic combo-driven action games with fluid chaining, beautiful chi blasts, attractive heroes, and premium UI presentation
genre_archetype: chapter-based side-scrolling fantasy combo brawler with aerial juggle routing and chi-finisher crowd control
camera_perspective: side-view side-scrolling combat lane with slight depth stacking
control_model: landscape virtual stick plus light attack, heavy attack, jump, dodge, and chi art buttons with input buffering
core_loop_signature: advance through linked combat arenas, chain grounded and aerial combos, build chi, spend chi on spectacular finishers, defeat elites and bosses, and upgrade persistent techniques
differentiation_axes: multi-enemy lane-clearing combo focus rather than short duel-only trials
chi-finisher spectacle as a core spend loop rather than a single burst skill
chapter-length progression with gated combat scenes and boss climaxes
aerial juggle routing and cancel windows tuned for continuous mobile touch combat
fantasy martial presentation distinct from office, district-control, or loot-first brawlers
forbidden_template_reuse: do not reduce the project to one-room arena survival
do not replace chapter push stages with boss-rush only progression
do not reuse office street or district capture framing from earlier brawlers
do not ship with one ground enemy family plus one boss only
do not collapse chi arts into one generic fireball projectile

map_content_budget.play_area_model: linked side-scrolling combat scenes with traversal strips, gated encounters, and dedicated boss arenas
map_content_budget.route_or_region_count: 6 chapters with at least 4 stage nodes each, including 1 boss node per chapter
map_content_budget.interactive_regions: combat lane center, lane-depth dodge space, traversal strips, hazard corners, breakable prop pockets, checkpoint nodes
map_content_budget.decorative_prop_count: minimum 6 decorative prop families across chapters
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: horizontal follow camera with short lock arenas and boss-room framing

special_rules: combat gates lock until wave clear
boss phase transitions at health thresholds
chi gain scales with uninterrupted hit chains
air juggle duration decays if repeated too long
risk_reward_systems: longer combos generate more chi and score
late finisher timing yields bonus rewards
aggressive aerial routes expose the hero to anti-air counters
failure_pressure_variants: surround pressure from mixed enemy packs
boss enrage attacks in final phase

asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: medium-plus 2D action animation with anticipation and recovery on hero and bosses
asset_variety_budget.minimum_distinct_sprite_families: at least 9 distinct gameplay sprite families before VFX variants
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: reuse must remain style-matched and role-specific; do not clone the same enemy body across all families or reuse a previous brawler pack without visual identity adaptation
